quality.description: Article-number pagination may hide full papers. These records currently supply no DB-focus evidence.

quality.label: Review sparse exact matches
quality.description: Accepted exact-name matches with no recorded affiliation or ORCID and other name candidates. These need evidence review; they are not confirmed errors.

quality.label: All PC members: possible additions (what-if)
quality.description: Broader scenario across all qualifying PC members: every unverified DB work proves to be a full paper. These excluded people are not authors in the study-cohort branch and are not added automatically.

quality.label: Check publication display categories
quality.description: Retained works with open conference-versus-workshop track questions in the manual review ledger. This is separate from unverified DB-focus evidence and does not remove publications.

quality.label: Check identity matches
quality.description: An alternative name candidate has stronger affiliation evidence. This check does not find every incorrect match.

quality.label: Records skipped before display
quality.description: Missing or invalid year, title or DBLP key in the deduplicated input. Checked before the website loader skips records.

quality.label: Incomplete source records
quality.description: Missing or invalid year, title or DBLP key in the original publication scan. May overlap with skipped input records.

quality.label: Missing display affiliation
quality.description: Checks included researchers only. A present affiliation is not proof that it is current or correct.

quality.label: Incomplete author order
quality.description: Checks retained main ML papers in the study cohort. These links cannot enter author-position charts.

limits: Coverage is not accuracy. These checks use collected service names and scanned publications; they cannot count people or papers the sources missed. Review flags can overlap. Study exclusions and linked versions are not data errors.
